stdin_script:
set -u
printf 'BASH: '; bash --version | head -n 1
printf 'NODE: '; node --version
for f in /frozen/solution/solve.sh /frozen/tests/test.sh; do bash -n "$f"; printf 'bash -n %s exit=%s\n' "$f" "$?"; done
node --check /frozen/solution/app/server.js; printf 'server.js node --check exit=%s\n' "$?"
node --check /frozen/solution/app/vite.config.mjs; printf 'vite.config.mjs node --check exit=%s\n' "$?"
for f in /frozen/solution/app/public/assets/*.js; do node --input-type=module --check < "$f"; printf 'browser bundle node --check %s exit=%s\n' "$f" "$?"; done
bash /frozen/solution/solve.sh; printf 'exact solve.sh exit=%s\n' "$?"
printf 'exact installed startup:\n'
timeout 8 env PORT=3000 DB_PATH=/app/app.db node /app/server.js
printf 'exact installed startup exit=%s\n' "$?"
printf 'Linux global-dependency control with identical server/public bytes:\n'
mkdir -p /tmp/row51-control
cp /frozen/solution/app/server.js /tmp/row51-control/server.js
cp -a /frozen/solution/app/public /tmp/row51-control/public
env PORT=3000 DB_PATH=/tmp/row51-control.db node /tmp/row51-control/server.js >/tmp/row51-control.log 2>&1 &
control_pid=$!
sleep 1
node -e 'Promise.all([fetch("http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health").then(async r=>console.log("health",r.status,await r.text())),fetch("http://127.0.0.1:3000/").then(async r=>console.log("workspace",r.status,"bytes",(await r.text()).length)),fetch("http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/snippets").then(async r=>console.log("snippets",r.status,await r.text()))]).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1})'
printf 'control probe exit=%s\n' "$?"
cat /tmp/row51-control.log
kill "$control_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$control_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
